readings.Aries: Your courage is not in question. Neither is the value of strategic patience. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Taurus: You accumulate experiences the way sediment accumulates — quietly, completely, permanently. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Gemini: There's a feeling underneath the thinking. Stop analysing it long enough to feel it. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Cancer: The tide moves regardless of whether you're watching. What you feel today will shift. Let it. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Leo: The stage you've been avoiding is smaller than you imagine, and the audience is ready. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Virgo: Your eye for what's wrong is excellent. Your eye for what's right — exercise it today. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Libra: The mirror you hold up to others reflects you too. What do you see? Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Scorpio: You are harder to hurt than you used to be. Some of that armour is now in the way. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Sagittarius: Your range is extraordinary. Today something narrow requires your full attention. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Capricorn: Something you dismissed as soft is actually what's needed right now. Recalibrate. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Aquarius: You've been talking about changing something for long enough that the talking has become a substitute for changing. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Pisces: There is something you've been trying to hold together that wants to fall apart constructively. Let it. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
